title: Recording: Every Man Has A Woman Who Loves Him, (Just Like) Starting Over, Give Me Something by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

An overdub session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 18 September 1980.

It began with vocals by both for ‘Every Man Has A Woman Who Loves Him’. They were photographed in the vocal booth by Kishin Shinoyama, who had taken images of the couple in Manhattan earlier in the day.

Lennon then attempted to record touch-up vocals on ‘(Just Like) Starting Over’, but was unhappy with his voice, so attention turned to Ono’s ‘Give Me Something’.
